paragraphs.text: Hi there, I'm Krishna, and I enjoy research, designing and building things. I'm an engineer with a mechanical degree, and expertise across AI and full-stack. I take pride in designing and building thoughtful products for people. I enjoy working most at the intersection of AI, robotics, and backend engineering, where research meets user needs.
Currently, I'm a Member of Technical Staff at

, where I work on LLMs and Robotics and help build new products like Neryva Agent Studio and PhaseForge. I lead the engineering effort in system architecture, harness, and safety, partnering closely with engineers from different teams to ensure accessibility and quality are built into the foundations of everything that we ship.
In my spare time, I enjoy building robots, reading books, hiking, playing football, and camping with my friends
